option_relations.rationale: Lupus erythematosus profundus is a subtype of lupus erythematosus, which is related to discoid lupus erythematosus
Linear or annular lupus erythematosus panniculitis of the scalp (LALPS) is closely related to discoid lupus erythematosus, especially given the scalp involvement
Discoid lupus erythematosus is a direct match for one of the leaf labels
Lupus panniculitis (lupus profundus) is a subtype of lupus erythematosus, which is related to discoid lupus erythematosus
